boarding_houses: MacGibbon House (boys Y9-11), Rutherford House (boys Y11-13), Thompson House (girls Y9-13)
contact_title: Director of Boarding and Head of Hauora (Director of Boarding since 2019)
alt_email: SGE@stac.school.nz (Struan George, Assistant Director of Boarding & MacGibbon House Manager); IWH@stac.school.nz (Ian White, Rutherford House Manager); LGO@stac.school.nz (Liz Gormack, Thompson House Manager); reception@stac.school.nz
gap_notes: Each house has a house manager plus tutors who supervise prep (6.30-8.30pm), sign-outs and weekend activities. No explicit 'gap tutor' page found, but the tutor-based model and Matt Parr's own UK teaching background make it a strong fit. Pitch rugby coaching and academic tutoring directly to him.
rugby_notes: Won the 2026 Miles Toyota 1st XV Premiership final 33-17 over Christchurch Boys' High, then the South Island title, which put them in the 2026 National Top Four. Alumni include Richie Mo'unga and Ben Blair. Currently the top 1st XV in the region.
scenery_notes: Leafy north-west Christchurch next to Hagley Park and the Avon. Port Hills and Sumner/New Brighton beaches close by. About 1-1.5 hr to Mt Hutt, Porters and Castle Hill for skiing and tramping. Strong outdoor education programme.
notes: Staff emails use 3-letter codes (first initial + first two letters of surname) @stac.school.nz. Only co-ed boarding school in Canterbury. Boarding fee 2026 about $20,600 on top of tuition.

boarding_houses: School House, Richards House, Flower's House (3 boarding houses out of 10)
contact_title: Deputy Headmaster - Student Care (boarding sits under this portfolio; no 'Director of Boarding' is currently listed)
alt_email: Housemasters (all verified in 2026 house booklets): hrsmith@christscollege.com (Henry Smith, School House; head rowing coach); kharris@christscollege.com (Kevin Harris, Richards House); mellismartin@christscollege.com (Monique Ellis-Martin, Flower's House). Deputies: cnicolson@, zknight@, keri.campbell@christscollege.com. General: receptionist@christscollege.com
gap_notes: The 2026 house booklets list 'Residential Tutors and Non-Residential Tutors' in each boarding house, and Wikipedia describes live-in tutors, often university students. Found no page naming UK gap tutors specifically. A housemaster role there was once advertised as starting as a Flower's House boarding tutor. Consider emailing Ben Vink and copying the relevant Housemaster.
rugby_notes: Plays the Canterbury Miles Toyota 1st XV Premiership and was a 2025 finalist. Traditional rival of Christchurch Boys' High (the College Match, since 1892). Has an annual fixture with Whanganui Collegiate. Claims rugby was played at the school from 1853.
scenery_notes: Heritage campus in central Christchurch next to Hagley Park and the Botanic Gardens. Quick access to the Port Hills, beaches, and Mt Hutt/Porters ski fields (about 1-1.5 hr). Year 10 boarders do the Duke of Edinburgh Bronze award.
notes: The website hides emails behind JavaScript forms, but they are printed in the 2026 PDFs/flipbooks. An older, now-404 'Director of Boarding' page named Darrell Thatcher, who is now listed as Senior Deputy Headmaster. Boarding fee about $22,250 (2025).

boarding_houses: Adams House (blocks: Straven, Worcester, Harakeke), 5 min walk from school beside the Avon. NOTE: the house is Adams House, not 'Rolleston House' (Rolleston is a Christ's College day house).
gap_notes: Adams House advertises supervised prep, peer support and private tutors. No public mention of gap tutors found. Lattitude Global Volunteering has listed CBHS among Christchurch boarding-school options, so still worth a direct approach.
rugby_notes: The traditional rugby powerhouse of the region. Won the 2025 Miles Toyota Premiership and 2025 South Island titles, and lost the 2026 final to StAC. National Top 4 in 2018. National 1st XV champions 2004 (shared), 2005 and 2006, and Sanix World Youth champions 2006. About 46 All Blacks among old boys.
scenery_notes: Adams House has 3 acres on the Avon River near Hagley Park. Christchurch base gives easy access to the Port Hills, beaches, and ski fields about 1-1.5 hr away (Mt Hutt, Porters, Craigieburn).
notes: Staff emails use 3-letter codes @cbhs.nz. Boarders are mainly from the rural South Island. Boarding fee $19,100.

boarding_houses: On-campus boarding school: Durham (Y9-10), Jarrow (Y11-12), Wearmouth (Y13)
alt_email: shand@stbedes.school.nz (Stephen Hand, Boarding Manager); wstruthers@stbedes.school.nz (Will Struthers, Boarding Dean); boarding@stbedes.school.nz (boarding office); jmcdowall@stbedes.school.nz (Rector Jon McDowall); office@stbedes.school.nz
gap_notes: The 2026 Boarding Handbook lists 'Residential Assistants' (Reuben Spicer, Alex Brown), which is the typical gap/young-adult live-in role. The handbook also mentions peer tutoring and specialist-subject group tutoring. No explicit UK gap page found. A LinkedIn result names Mark Vincent as Director of Boarding, but he is not in the 2026 handbook, so treat that as outdated.
rugby_notes: Plays the Canterbury Miles Toyota 1st XV Premiership. Strong rugby tradition: old boys include All Black Elliot Dixon, Japan captain Michael Leitch and Wales' Josh Navidi.
scenery_notes: Large 22 ha green campus at Christchurch's northern entrance. Close to the Waimakariri River and northern beaches. About 1-1.5 hr to Mt Hutt/Porters ski fields and Arthur's Pass.
notes: Email pattern is first initial + surname @stbedes.school.nz. The only Catholic boys' boarding college in the South Island.

alt_email: managerre@timaruboys.school.nz (Christine Murdoch, Residential Manager); tbhs@timaruboys.school.nz (main office)
gap_notes: The Thomas House handbook has a 'Gap Tutors' section ('assistance of Gap tutors who assist with prep'). School news has featured UK gappies joining Thomas House for a year, e.g. Luke Baker from Hertfordshire. Lattitude also places volunteers in Timaru. Very strong fit.
rugby_notes: Plays the Canterbury Miles Toyota 1st XV Premiership (e.g. v St Andrew's in 2026) and South Island boys' school fixtures. Reached its first UC Cup final in 2017. Old boys include All Black Archie Strang and Scotland's Brendan Laney.
scenery_notes: Coastal Timaru (Caroline Bay). About 1-1.5 hr to Mt Dobson, Fox Peak and Roundhill ski fields, Lake Tekapo and the Mackenzie Basin, and about 2.5 hr to Aoraki/Mt Cook. Good base for skiing, tramping and lakes.
notes: The Director of Boarding email is a role address (named person Steve Blair per the staff page and ERO). Housemasters listed: Darren Robertson (also Hostel Assistant Manager), Miro MacDonald, Sam Sugar, Jordan Walker, Nathan Archibald. Boarding fee 2026 $16,900.
